section_summary.extract_value: This is the conclusion section of a single study (Study 1) investigating relationships between body appreciation in men and conformity to masculine norms, upward appearance-based social comparisons, and physical activity frequency. The study is the first to examine whether body appreciation differs between sexual minority and heterosexual men and to test potential mediators of this relationship, with implications for developing effective body image interventions for men.
